events.name: Fall Hackathon 2026
events.description: A 12-hour build sprint open to all majors. Form a team or join one on the day — prizes for the top three projects.

events.name: Open Studio Night
events.description: Drop in, grab a canvas or a lump of clay, and make something. All materials provided, no experience needed.

events.name: Campus 10K Fun Run
events.description: Our annual timed 10K loop around campus, followed by a pancake breakfast at the finish line.

events.name: Regional Debate Invitational
events.description: Teams from six regional universities compete. Come watch the finals or sign up to judge a round.

events.name: Community Garden Clean-Up Day
events.description: Help prep the garden beds for fall planting. Gloves and tools provided — bring water and sun protection.

events.name: Open Mic & Acoustic Night
events.description: Sign up for a 10-minute slot or just come listen. Coffee and snacks on the house.

events.name: Startup Pitch Night
events.description: Five student teams pitch their startup ideas to a panel of local founders and investors.

events.name: International Culture Fair
events.description: Food, music, and performances from over twenty countries represented on campus. Everyone welcome.

events.name: Board Game Marathon
events.description: A full day of tabletop games — bring a favorite to teach or come learn something new.
